verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents its own deletion-related controls for physical mail. Unwanted mail is shredded on-site, destruction certificates are available on request, and users can ask that mail not be opened or scanned at all. Nothing shows that users can set retention periods for, or delete, the scanned digital copies, which are kept in 'unlimited cloud storage'. Missing for 10: user-controlled deletion of stored scans and account data, configurable retention periods, API or programmatic deletion controls, a documented retention policy, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
